description:
Rewrite all `use_observable` call sites in the example apps to `use_cell`:

- `examples/cart/lib/cart_web/components/cart.ex`, `cart_badge.ex`, `cart_items.ex`
- `examples/collaboration/lib/collaboration_web/components/document_editor.ex`
- `examples/inventory/lib/inventory_web/hooks.ex` (this is a wrapper layer; update accordingly)
- `examples/todo/lib/todo_web/components/todo_list.ex`, `examples/todo/lib/todo/store.ex` (docstring reference)

After migration, each example must compile and pass its existing tests, and behave identically when checked in Chrome:
- cart: add-to-cart, totals update
- collaboration: edit-lock acquire/release
- inventory: hold/release with stock decrement
- todo: add item, toggle complete

Do not delete `use_observable` yet — that happens in T9 once the rename in T8 is done.
title: Migrate 4 example apps from use_observable to use_cell
